verdict.rationale: The FTB holds taxpayer data through MyFTB and Web Pay, so a data-use or AI-training privacy posture is a fair question for this service. The evidence pack contains only two edge-denial probes (403 at robots.txt and at the webapp host), which say nothing about an AI-training opt-out or data-use policy. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
